title: Singleton coalitional influence
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $b\in\{−1,1\}$. The influence of the singleton coalition $\{i\}$ toward $b$ equals half the probability that flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
